runtime.publicContentLimit: category.contents clamps request limit by maxPublicContentRows
runtime.publicTreeLimit: category.list public clamps output by maxPublicTreeRows
runtime.treeObservability: category list/detail rows expose childCount and contentCount so admin UI can explain delete protection and tree density
runtime.deleteProtectionCounts: category delete rejection returns childCount and contentCount instead of only a generic error message
runtime.treeUi: category admin page provides local expand/collapse controls over the bounded tree table without adding request hot-path cost
runtime.treeSummaryUi: category admin page shows loaded, visible, and collapsed node counts from the bounded tree result
runtime.treeFilterContextUi: category admin page keyword filter keeps matching rows with ancestor and descendant context from the bounded tree result
runtime.categoryBindTable: content_category_bind stores category membership when content.category is enabled while content_item.category_id remains compatibility mirror
runtime.categoryBindBackfill: schema ensure backfills content_category_bind from legacy content_item.category_id when the category pack is enabled
runtime.categoryBindDiagnostics: category.bind.status reports legacy mirror rows, active bind rows, missing bind rows, and mismatch rows as an admin-only migration check
runtime.categoryBindDriftSamples: category.bind.status returns bounded missingSamples and mismatchSamples rows for admin-only migration diagnostics
runtime.categoryBindAdminBackfill: category.bind.backfill explicitly reruns the bounded legacy mirror backfill before physical mirror removal
runtime.categoryBindDiagnosticsUi: ability page renders category.bind.status as fixed migration metric tables while retaining raw JSON diagnostics
runtime.categoryBindBackfillUi: ability page renders category.bind.backfill result as a bounded migration result table
runtime.categoryBindWritePaths: content save, delete, import commit and revision restore synchronize content_category_bind when content.category is enabled
runtime.adminTreeFilter: category admin page provides local keyword filtering over the bounded tree result without adding request hot-path cost
runtime.sortLimit: category.sort rejects item arrays beyond maxSortRows
runtime.requestLimit: category save/delete/sort reject request bodies beyond maxRequestBytes before JSON parse
runtime.statusValidation: category save normalizes status to enabled/disabled values before writing
runtime.accessIntegration: category.contents filters restricted content when content.access is enabled; category.list/detail hide aggregate content counts when access is mounted
